name: code-index
description: A compact symbol index, markdown section maps and task tags, so Claude reads the index and a few lines instead of whole files.

indexPath.title: Index path
indexPath.description: Where /index writes the index, relative to the project root. A .json path writes JSON; anything else writes markdown.

include.title: Files to index
include.description: Comma-separated globs (**, *, ?, {a,b}). A glob with no slash matches at any depth.

exclude.title: Files to skip
exclude.description: Comma-separated globs never indexed. In a git repository, .gitignore is honoured as well.

statusTag.title: Task tag name
statusTag.description: The comment tag that marks where a task stands, as in // STATUS(<task>): OPEN -- what is left.

python.title: Python
python.description: The Python 3.9+ executable that runs the scripts (python, python3, py, or a full path).
